description: This Java source file defines the ResizePolicy class, which manages resizability states and constraints for UI widgets, including directions and aspect ratio preservation. It includes factory methods, property checks, and applies logic based on component and position.

classes.name: ResizePolicy
classes.description: Manages resizability constraints for UI components, including directions and aspect ratio preservation, with factory methods and property checks.

methods.name: isResizable
methods.description: Checks if the policy allows resizing in any direction.

methods.name: topAllowed
methods.description: Checks if resizing the top edge is allowed.

methods.name: rightAllowed
methods.description: Checks if resizing the right edge is allowed.

methods.name: bottomAllowed
methods.description: Checks if resizing the bottom edge is allowed.

methods.name: leftAllowed
methods.description: Checks if resizing the left edge is allowed.

methods.name: isAspectPreserving
methods.description: Checks if resizing requires aspect ratio preservation.

methods.name: full
methods.description: Returns a policy allowing resizing in all directions.

methods.name: none
methods.description: Returns a policy disallowing all resizing.

methods.name: horizontal
methods.description: Returns a policy allowing horizontal resizing only.

methods.name: vertical
methods.description: Returns a policy allowing vertical resizing only.

methods.name: scaled
methods.description: Returns a policy allowing scaled/aspect-ratio preserving resizing only.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a custom ResizePolicy with specified edges and aspect ratio preservation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a ResizePolicy based on a string description.

methods.name: getResizePolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the ResizePolicy for a given component, considering palette item overrides.

methods.name: applies
methods.description: Checks if the resize policy applies to a given direction or position.
